messages:
Maya: quick sync — proposing a phased rollout for compliance profiles (BYOK + SOC2/ISO + retention tiers). want alignment on legal-hold behavior across tiers and keystore SLA handoffs.
Samir: +1. can you outline phases and gating criteria?
Maya: Phase 1: internal pilot (subset of customers, read-only audit export + soft legal-hold flag), Phase 2: opt-in customers (full BYOK handshake + export UI), Phase 3: GA (tenant-level legal-hold, immutable snapshots). gating: keystore escrow integration, retention export perf, SOC2 evidence packaging.
Ryan: ops note — legal-hold needs a runbook. if hold=true we must stop background archival and surface a snapshot export endpoint with admin ACLs. also need retention metrics to avoid paying cold-store for stuck holds.
Anna: legal: any legal-hold must preserve chain-of-custody metadata (actor, timestamp, reason). export must be tamper-evident (signed manifest). also need the ability to apply temporary hold vs perpetual.
Lisa: security: BYOK handshake must guarantee keywrap + proof-of-originality. For pilot we can support KMS v1 (AWS/GCP) and a minimal HSM path for enterprise. need threat model doc before phase 2.
Samir: question on implementation: do we toggle deletion at the object-store layer or keep a separate hold index? toggling object-store retention could be costly.
Ryan: prefer separate hold index + enforcement in ingest/archival jobs. cheaper and simpler to rollback.
Maya: agreement: hold index + enforcement in pipeline. Samir, plan for instrumentation so we can query "holds impacting archive" per-tenant.
Samir: will add metrics: hold_count, held_bytes, last_unhold_event. estimate: +0.5 engineer for 3 sprints to mature.
Anna: need product policy doc for temporary vs legal perpetual hold. also define SLA for customer requests to lift holds (legal review steps).
Maya: proposed SLA: 48h initial review for opt-in customers, 7 days for enterprise with concierge. open to feedback.
Lisa: for SOC2 evidence we need audit snapshots that include model version, prompt/response hashes, and keystore key_id. build that into the evidence manifest.
Samir: implementation detail: attach manifest as sidecar JSON in snapshot bucket. example: `{"snapshot_id":"s-123","created_by":"user@acme","model":"redwood-v1","keystore_id":"ks-456"}`
Ryan: ops question — export performance target? we should set an indexable export SLA: 30 minutes for <=100GB snapshot retrieval to start.
Maya: callout: 30m/100GB is a reasonable pilot target. we'll measure and refine.
Anna: one more legal ask — ability to freeze export until subpoena/question answered. add a flag `export_held` and audit trail.
Samir: technical: can add `export_held` in manifest and block the export endpoint if present. default false.
Maya: action items: 1) Samir — design hold-index + manifest schema (due EOD Friday). 2) Ryan — draft runbook + metric dashboard (due next Wed). 3) Anna — legal-hold policy doc (template by next Tue). 4) Lisa — threat model + BYOK path doc (by end of sprint).
Samir: noted. I'll include schema with example queries for ops.
Ryan: I'll prototype runbook steps and a simple Prometheus dashboard.
Anna: will circulate policy template to product & security for comments.
deploy-bot: canary deployment for `hold-index` prototype succeeded in staging at 1766666120 :rocket:
Maya: thanks. next sync: Monday 10am PT to review artifacts and decide phase gating.
Lisa: hv a couple integration questions — adding to Monday agenda.
Samir: FYI — may need a short spike to validate export perf on cold archives.
Maya: ok. I'll add spike to roadmap and tag it as required for Phase 2 gating.
Ryan: noted. logging: please include `hold.apply` and `hold.release` events in audit stream.
Anna: +1. those events are required for compliance evidence.
Maya: great. closing thread for now — I'll post the agenda doc and owners in the product board. :thumbsup:
